EXIT_STATUS: Unit properties and independently observed workload exits
FAILURE_RULE: Manager or observer failure/unknown termination => incomplete, no retry
OBSERVER_ROLE: Outside service failure domain, record grant/claim/unit identities, properties, kernel values, deadlines, exit/membership and causal failure
POST_TERMINATION_MEMBERSHIP: Every resource-controller unit group empty/no unknown task; capture before collection
SERVICE_TYPE: Type=exec candidate; avoid Type=oneshot for RuntimeMaxSec; no notify extension mechanism enabled
TERMINATION_TRIGGER: RuntimeMaxSec expiration then stop timeout and final control-group kill
TIME_SOURCE: Manager runtime deadline must be independently witnessed with external monotonic launch/stop timestamps
WATCHDOG_OWNER: System manager candidate independent of workload parent; not a separate authorization
WATCHDOG_RESOURCE_BOUNDARY: Manager is an external trusted OS control-plane candidate, not silently included in six application lifetimes or exempted by a grant; explicit permitted external facility accounting/trust scope required
